configuration.training_data: Only the same 390 ESC-50 original recordings selected by current v11; five official folds, source separated
configuration.augmentation: Training only: +/-12 dB gain shift, up to 3 mel-band mask, up to 30-frame time mask on 30% of samples, normalized Gaussian noise std .02
configuration.selection: One architecture and fixed epoch count decided before any new model external result. No epoch or threshold selection from external recordings.
configuration.cv: Each of five models trains on four official folds and tests on the fifth, including source-ID overlap assertions; no external training
configuration.normalization: Per mel band mean/std of training folds only; final model uses all ESC training recordings only
configuration.file_decision: Mean causal frame logits over original recording, then softmax/argmax; Python and C must use exactly this same rule
configuration.streaming: Maintain STFT/pre-emphasis and causal convolution states across input callbacks; emit every 10 frames (100 ms); no 1 s/3 s capture reset
configuration.streaming_decoder: Prototype EMA of frame logits alpha=.02; no live threshold tuned on external set. File accuracy remains a separate mean-logit metric.
configuration.protected_hash_basis: Git baseline blob bytes; original training checkout had platform-specific line endings
